description: Simulate a message from a contact to one of your numbers.

from.description: Who texts your app: the user's number.

media.description: Files sent with the message, as MMS or WhatsApp media.

template_id.description: The payload template for the inbound webhook, instead of the number's (e.g. `twilio.inbound_sms`).

to.description: Your app's number that receives it, usually a virtual number.

webhook_endpoint_ids.description:
Send this action's webhooks to exactly these endpoints (IDs from
`GET /api/v1/webhooks/endpoints`) instead of the ones the rules pick; an empty list
sends none. Leave it out to let the rules decide.

webhook_requests.description:
Payloads edited for this action, by endpoint: each body is sent as written instead of
the rendered one. Leave it out to send the rendered payloads.

name: sendmock_sms_simulate_inbound
